name: PLEX - Transition Status
description: Applies the card-driven transitions in rulesv1.2.json stateMachines.assignmentStatus. Called by the Power App and by the agent's adaptive cards.

trigger.type: Request (When an agent calls the flow)

inputs.card: ReturnToRVSR | CorrectionComplete | ReturnForAwardCorrection | Authorize | ConcurApproved | ConcurDenied | ContinueAtAuth | ExcludeClaim

actions.default: Respond with an error: transition not allowed

set.PL_reworkIndicated: true when <to> is RVSRCorrection or AwardCorrection

actions.description: On first GAP completion stamp PL_GAPerOfRecord and PL_GappedByTeam. On Authorize stamp PL_AuthOfRecord and PL_AuthByTeam. AwardCorrection (bucket 4) routes back to these people.
Enrich recomputes PL_Bucket because AwardCorrection moves a claim to bucket 4
card = ExcludeClaim sets PL_Excluded = true and PL_ExcludedReason; no state change
